baseline.fixed_core: Replay core/C=.1 against saved additive predictions; mark reused vsnew correctly

gate.CI: paired common-site bootstrap2000, nominal old reused development; CI not hard gate
gate.against_context: mean delta>0, at least2nonnegative old quarters, worst delta>=-.005
gate.against_matched_fixed_core: mean delta>0 and at least2nonnegative old quarters for the corresponding raw/blend variant
gate.final_fit: Only if any algorithm variant passes both gates; one selected-majority recipe full fit or verified exact duplicate reuse; emit qualifying predefined variants only

representation_definitions.compact_all_splines: Same compact90numeric; degree2 fit-quantile splines for all90 fields after fixed count log transform, constants zero
representation_definitions.core: Original AdditiveLogitTransform compact96-minus-year/cutoff,90 numeric4OHE,4degree2spline fields; exact original behavior
representation_definitions.core_interactions: Original core plus two fixed OHE tuples risk×area and risk×quarter
representation_definitions.core_recency4: Original core; logistic sample weights 2**(-quarter_age/4), normalized mean1; dates only in weights
representation_definitions.full_context: All base346 columns, same exclusions/categories/core4splines and fixed count/age logs
representation_definitions.own_history: All original non-ctx274 columns, omit absolute year/cutoff, quarter plus original categoricals OHE, core4splines, fixed count/age log linear remainder

runtime.cache_reuse: Job key is validation quarter+recipe; Q3/Q4 outer jobs may coincide with later inner jobs, without affecting earlier recipe choice

scope: New six-hour additive/GAM branch; old frozen modules unchanged

selection.final_recipe: Majority of3inner winners; tie equal-quarter mean inner AP across all3 numerical-valid inner jobs, then smaller C/complexity/ID; no later-quarter tuning
selection.numerical_invalid: ConvergenceWarning/numerical failure checkpoint explicit invalid for that recipe/inner; never drop an outer quarter; all invalid -> stop
selection.outer_predictions: ONLY sequentially selected algorithm and fixed original core/C=.1 control; never score all24 recipes as outer candidate panel
selection.rule: For each outer, train24recipes only on periods<previous-inner-quarter; select highest inner AP, tie smaller C then fixed complexity order then ID; fit/reuse selected recipe strictly before outer

transform_rules.generalized_log_rule: Non-core-view count/total/n/n_visits/_days fields nonnegative: log1p; core4burden splines kept raw outside all-spline view; signed violation_change_last_vs_mean never log
transform_rules.scaling: StandardScaler on continuous/spline columns, binary flags/OHE unchanged
transform_rules.tails: constant and clip observed fit minima/maxima
